_comment: Executable + packaging contract for @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, asserted by sdk-contract.test.ts. The lockfile pins the concrete SDK version; the SDK's platform executable packages pin the bundled Claude Code executable; this fixture records the tested SDK<->CC pair so an upstream drift (a lockfile refresh that moves either version, or a repackaging that drops the bundled executables / changes the peer-dep ranges we absorb) surfaces as a failing test rather than silent behavior change. Regenerate deliberately when intentionally bumping the SDK: copy the installed package's version / claudeCodeVersion / peerDependencies / optionalDependencies keys here.
